turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best result with your kit, start by securing your wooden wicks to the bottom center of the vessels using the included wick stickers and clips.
Next, melt the soy wax completely using your melter, stir in the fragrance oil thoroughly with the bamboo mixing spoon, and pour carefully into each vessel. Allow the candles to cool and set completely at room temperature before trimming the wicks to about 3/16 inch prior to lighting!
